evidence.why: Complete accessory control flow, attempts, arithmetic, branch order and completion guards.
Completion helper conditionally removes a controller rumble ID rather than changing item state.

facts.rationale: Replaces the baseline's capped-delay and generic cleanup description with the actual ordered comparisons, attempt counting, same-invocation active processing, canonical alternate-member access and inspected rumble consumer.
facts.value: With no held item, performs no accessory processing. Otherwise absence of held A latches xC=1. x10 increments by 1 only while below x5B0, then resets on pressed A only if it remains below x5B0; it is not clamped and a threshold-reaching update cannot reset it. A true ftCheckThrowB0 result sets x14=1, performs feedback and an emission attempt, increments x8 even when the emission branch is skipped, conditionally runs two fighter updates using frame % interval == interval-1, and sets animation rate to zero. The subsequent independent x14==1 block runs in that same invocation. It decrements itemthrow.x4 but tests/resets mv.ca.specialhi.vel.x; their layout equivalence is unresolved. It separately decrements itemthrow.facing_dir, reloads it at <=0, and repeats an emission attempt and attempt-count update. After that, x8>=x5A4, xC!=0 and x10>=x5B0 jointly clear x14, restore rate 1, and request rumble removal via ftCommon_8007ECD4(fp,1). This last call is not an item-state cleanup. No local validation protects zero modulo interval, extreme counters, nonfinite thresholds or invalid object/common-data pointers.
